name: app-header
purpose: The fleet's brand bar in navy and light: a custom per-app brand (hexagon-family icon + the app's own wordmark, the nimiq.school 'Nimiq.school' style) with a built-in flag-hex language selector, an optional network badge and a tools slot for the connect-wallet-pill. The plain horizontal-white Nimiq logo stays as the fallback brand. Replaces the header block 15 apps hand-roll per page.

props.name: appName
props.description: Custom brand mode, the DEFAULT for fleet apps (Andjroo, 2026-07-10): the #icon slot (or the universal hexagon) + this name in the 'Nimiq.school' wordmark style (17px/700, no tracking). Omit for the fallback horizontal-white Nimiq logo. Never combine any icon with that logo (rule 4).

props.name: slot: icon
props.description: The app's own hexagon-family brand icon, 24px, drawn in currentColor so it reads navy on light and white on navy (class app-header-icon). Namespace its gradient/clip ids per instance (rule 3). The demo carries the nimiq.school globe-with-check verbatim; the universal hexagon is the default.

props.name: variant
props.description: Surface. navy = the radial --nimiq-blue-bg bar (rule 7). light = the nimiq.school bar: #FAFAFA, hairline box-shadow 0 1px 0 rgba(31,35,72,.08) instead of a border, navy ink; works sticky (host sets position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50). html variant: add class app-header--light.

props.name: languages
props.description: The built-in language selector (the nimiq.school NavBar pattern): the button shows ONLY the current language's flag-hex + a small caret; the dropdown lists flag + native name. Flags are vendored flag-icons files per the flag-hex precedent (fit pans/zooms per flag, e.g. us { aspect: 4/3 }); never a flag CDN. html variant: author the trigger + list markup and wire it with initLanguageMenu (app-header.js).

props.name: language
props.description: Current language id, v-model:language compatible (pairs with the update:language emit; change fires too). html driver: 'change' CustomEvent (detail = id) + onChange callback.

props.name: badge
props.description: Network badge text (e.g. 'Testnet', 'Demo'), the wallet's testnet treatment: orange uppercase label on a white .07 chip (navy .07, the nq-button-s rest surface, on the light bar). Omit to hide.

props.name: slot: brand
props.description: Replaces the whole brand link. Default renders the custom brand (or the fallback logo).

props.name: slot: tools
props.description: Right-side cluster after the badge and language selector; the intended mount for connect-wallet-pill (class on-dark / variant dark on navy). Without badge, languages and tools the brand centers itself (the tipjar layout).

notes: ORIGINAL composition (flag-hex precedent), so verified:false; reference.png is still snapped from truth/truth.html and nq verify guards the demo against it as a regression check. v2, redesigned 2026-07-10 on Andjroo's direct feedback: 'All my app headers should have the language selector. The testnet/mainnet indicator is okay. All of them will have a custom logo... they'll say nimiq dot their app name and then they'll have the custom logo.' The flagship reference is nimiq.school (NavBar.vue + CommunityFooter.vue). Design decisions: (1) CUSTOM PER-APP BRAND IS THE DEFAULT: a 24px hexagon-family icon slot in currentColor + the app wordmark at 17px/700 with normal tracking (NavBar .nav-brand-name verbatim; v1 had 16px). The demo icon is the nimiq.school globe-with-check verbatim from CommunityFooter.vue (real Nimiq icon-set paths: nimiq--globe-filled + nimiq--check-thin; the green check gradient and its knockout ring kept exactly as shipped, ring fill set per surface so the knockout matches the bar; gradient ids namespaced nq-ah-check-<instance> per rule 3). The horizontal-white Nimiq logo is DEMOTED to the fallback brand for pages with no identity of their own; it keeps working (kept in demo, last) and still must never receive a second icon (rule 4). (2) TWO SURFACES: navy stays the v1 bar (radial --nimiq-blue-bg anchor bottom right per rule 7, 16px 20px padding); light is the nimiq.school NavBar surface verbatim: #FAFAFA, hairline box-shadow 0 1px 0 rgba(31,35,72,.08) (never a border), navy ink, sticky-safe. (3) BUILT-IN LANGUAGE SELECTOR, the NavBar pattern verbatim: trigger = current flag ONLY (24x22 flag-hex) + 10x6 caret, 38px/radius-8 ghost button (hover rgba(31,35,72,.06) on light per NavBar, white .07 on navy, the wallet testnet chip surface); dropdown = 220px white card, radius 10, shadow 0 4px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.16) (NavBar verbatim), options 14px/600 flag + NATIVE name, current in #0582CA (blue text on the white card, fine under rule 20). ARIA per the spec: aria-haspopup=listbox + aria-expanded on the trigger, role=listbox/option + aria-selected, outside-click + Escape close, everything tabbable with the house :focus-visible rings (#0582CA on light, #0CA6FE on navy per rule 20). Arrow-key roving is NOT carried: the flagship NavBar has none and options are real buttons on the tab order (radical simplicity). Closed headers may omit the list from the DOM entirely (the NavBar v-if pattern; the demo's closed instances do). (4) FLAGS are vendored artwork per the flag-hex precedent, never a CDN: the demo inlines exactly-drawable civil flag designs (de, fr, it, nl, jp rects/circle) inside the verbatim hexagon clip with the one gray fh-edge; real apps point <image href> at their vendored flag-icons files or pass flagUrl to FlagHex (Vue, dependsOn flag-hex; fit pans/zooms per flag, us { aspect: 4/3 } etc). (5) HTML DRIVER app-header.js (initLanguageMenu), the connect-wallet-pill driver precedent: dependency-free ES module, markup owns the languages, driver wires open/close/selection, re-suffixes cloned flag ids (rule 3) when swapping the trigger flag, dispatches 'change' (detail = id) + onChange. (6) BADGE unchanged (wallet Sidebar.vue .testnet-notice, orange = warning); on light the chip is rgba(31,35,72,.07), the shipped nq-button-s rest surface, because white .07 vanishes on #FAFAFA. nq lint reports the badge as a colored-uppercase warning; accepted deliberately with the upstream citation. nq lint's only other demo warning is off-scale spacing (10px brand gap, 7px option padding, 20px side padding): those values are the flagship NavBar and the v1 tipjar bar verbatim, kept over snapping to the scale so the header matches the shipped sites pixel for pixel. (7) MOBILE: safe-area insets kept; the bar is a container (container-type inline-size) so the wordmark yields below 420px when the tools cluster is full (2+ tools, :has probe) and spacing tightens one step; both the bar and the tools cluster flex-wrap instead of overflowing below that. Proven by the 360px demo instance (single row: icon + badge + lang + pill). (8) IDENTICON-BEARING pill states in the demos stay idle; the connected chip lives in connect-wallet-pill's own restaged demo. (9) No new colors, no ornament; the one calculated break stays the brand icon's gold/green accent. Fleet refs: nimiq.school NavBar.vue + CommunityFooter.vue (flagship), tipjar public/index.html .header, splitlink public/index.html .app-header, wallet Sidebar.vue testnet-notice. Pairs with connect-wallet-pill (mounted in the tools slot; its restaged demo mounts inside THIS header).
